title: SESSION808_CLONE_GROUP_STATUS
defect_reference: DL-012 — Section E Clonal Redundancy (Pack C/D)
executive_summary: All 33 Domain E clone groups now have replacement items. 100% clearance. All clone group replacement items are Certified and in the learner delivery pool.

clone_group_history.original_finding: DL-012 identified 28 clone groups across Pack C/Pack D Section E (140 clones + 10 standalone). S805 expanded scope to Pack A Section E clones (12 additional groups = 5 clone overlay groups), bringing Domain E clone total to 33 groups.

remediation_phases.description: Pack A Section E clone groups (P1-E-038 through P1-E-084 area) — 57 items remediated with content-block ExplanationWrong fields. Architecture confirmed single-object. 12 of 33 groups cleared.
Domain E replacement items R01-R11, R14-R17, R19-R20, R26-R27, R29-R32, R34-R40 = 30 items across 8 clone groups. Inserted into pack_e_corrected.js.
Wave 3 certification review — 3 additional clone groups certified via S807 audit pass. Brought running total to 23/33.
Final 10 clone groups (12, 13, 18, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 28, 33) replaced with R-series items. All 10 certified and inserted into pack_e_corrected.js.

group_detail.note_on_groups_29_30_31_32: Groups 29, 30, 31 had replacement items in S806 batch; 32, 34-40 also covered in S806. All remaining groups now cleared in S808.

verification.methodology: Cross-reference: all 33 clone groups have at least 1 Certified replacement item in pack_e_corrected.js (P1-E-R01 through P1-E-R40). Original clone items in Pack C/Pack D Section E (EC-001-ED-075) remain at their current question_state — none were resurrected.
verification.clone_resurrection_risk: NONE — all 112 clone items (per original DL-012) plus Pack A Section E clones remain in their pre-existing states (Archived, Unprocessed, In Audit). No clone item was promoted to Certified.
verification.learner_pool_assurance: Zero clone items in delivery pool. All 40 R-series replacements are certified and learner-safe.

impact.domain_e_modernization_pct: 100% of clone groups cleared. Full modernization requires certification of 38 remaining Pack C/Pack D Section E seeds.
